create_sequential_args_from_mapping: create SequentialArgs from a mapping of key-value pairs and convert to CLI argument strings
create_sequential_args_from_sequence: create SequentialArgs from a sequence of positional arguments and convert to a list of strings
test_merge_args: test merging multiple mappings and sequences into a single SequentialArgs with later values overriding earlier ones
test_sequential_args_to_dict: test converting SequentialArgs to a dictionary representation with boolean flags set to True
test_remove_args: test removing a nested key from SequentialArgs and verifying the remaining arguments
test_get_args_for_all_jobs: test extracting args from a nested JobGroup tree and propagating them to all leaf Jobs
